sections.text:
P R O F I L E
Senior CSR & ESG professional with 15+ years of experience leading enterprise sustainability, CSR governance, and social impact portfolios across corporate, multilateral, and government ecosystems. Deep expertise in Section 135 compliance, BRSR alignment, GRI sustainability reporting, and EU ESG regulations (CSRD, SFDR, CS3D, EBA Pillar 3). Track record of architecting multi-crore CSR portfolios with 97 99% fund utilisation and zero audit deviations, anchoring landmark public private partnerships, and embedding ESG governance frameworks aligned with global standards. Field-tested domain expertise in public health, NCD management, and community wellbeing directly relevant to sustainability-linked initiatives within the Health Insurance ecosystem.
